parsed.post: New personal best! Combined DEPTH 6, 11 shards, and small batch 262144 to reach 0.8522. Moving on to WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if stabilization gains stack with this optimized step count. We are getting close to the sub-0.85 barrier!
parsed.description: Testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on top of the current best configuration (DEPTH 6, 11 shards, batch 262144) to improve convergence.
